overview: The Watchtower Ring is the outer defensive perimeter of Katta Castellum, providing elevated surveillance and rapid response capability.
history: Constructed after early Loyalist‑Seru conflicts to ensure perimeter security.
Arcane wards were added to detect magical disturbances approaching the city.
Elite scouts were stationed to monitor mountain passes and sky routes.
The ring became the first line of defense against external threats.
hooks: A watchtower reports an unexplained arcane flare beyond the perimeter.
A sentry goes missing during a night patrol.
A Senate directive orders increased surveillance due to rising tensions.
A tower’s wardstone destabilizes, threatening a chain reaction.
